n.exclusions: Paper reports excluding estimates beyond mean ±4 SD after an estimate over 4 million; Results group sizes 240 + 199 correspond to t(437). Study reports 439 complete cases.

reported_success.quote: variety resulted in an increase rather than a decrease in perceived quantity

notes:
Supplied replication p. 13 is Table 3, not body Results p. 4. Table 3 reports d = -0.217 while body reports -0.218; retained body precision/value. Body calls the N=199 group multicolored even though design includes bicolored sets. Authors call replication of their opposite-direction Study 1 successful, but the original variety-reduces-quantity hypothesis failed. Original study identifier and candy/page locator conflict; original primary unavailable.
Source follow-up: Published article; title and DOI match the assigned reference. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. No conversion of the printed F statistic. Analytic N is left null: 105 recruited minus one documented exclusion implies 104 retained, but 104 is not printed as the target-test analytic sample and denominator df 99 remains unreconciled. Replication and reported_success are unassigned. Locator discrepancy: input study_o is 1, but the candy-pouring description and PDF p. 8 identify Study 3; Study 1 instead uses dots and shapes. Statistics here describe the located Study 3 test and do not establish a match to the supplied Study 1 identifier.
